Hi Ben / Olivia,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday — really appreciate the clear context on FinTechCo's latency SLOs and data residency constraints. As promised, attached is our SOC 2 packet (Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v2.pdf) which includes:
- SOC 2 Type II report (summary and control mappings)
- Data flow diagrams and retention policy
- List of relevant third-party subprocessors and certifications

Next suggested steps:
1) Share packet with your security/compliance team for an initial read (I can jump on a call if they'd like)
2) If there are any gaps, we can provide additional artifacts (config screenshots, SOC 2 bridge letter, or on-prem deployment notes)
3) If everything looks good, we can move forward with procurement and finalize the reserved capacity proposal (deal FT-7892)

If helpful, I'm happy to set a 15-min sync with your security lead this week to walk through the packet — what time zones work best?

Best,
